intro: Turn images, text and files from your clipboard into floating windows that stay within reach.
details.heading: Just enough.
details.intro: Keep your content close and get on with your work.
content.heading: Images
content.body: Switch between filling the window and fitting the whole image. Copy the original with one click.
placement.heading: Text
placement.body: Select, edit and copy text right in the window. Your edits are saved across restarts.
shortcut.heading: Files
shortcut.body: Browse icons or a list, open files or drag them to Finder. Right-click to rename or remove references.
closing.heading: Keep it close.
closing.body: Give your clipboard a place to stay.
title: Pir — Copy it. Keep it in sight.
description: Keep images, editable notes and files in sight with a lightweight macOS app.
start.heading: Keep it in sight in three steps.
start.copy.body: Copy an image, some text, or files and folders in Finder.
start.pin.body: Create a window from your clipboard in any app. The default is ⌘⇧V and you can change it in Preferences.
start.arrange.body: Drag a window to move it and resize from its edges. Hover to reveal the controls in the upper-left corner.
